title: 附件与图片的本地隐私处理

security_summary.type_decision: content signature only; extension and declared MIME must agree, mismatch is rejected
file_boundary: regular file only; symlink and reparse point rejected
current-user read permission required on POSIX
single open with O_NOFOLLOW plus fstat identity and size re-check
bounded streaming read; growth during read is refused
security_summary.image_sanitisation: orientation applied; always re-encoded; EXIF/GPS/XMP/ICC/comment and trailing container data dropped; derived bytes re-opened and checked; JPEG quality steps down to satisfy the byte limit
security_summary.reference_binding: account_scope + task_id + purpose + expires_at; derived sha256 re-verified on every read
security_summary.external_transfer: explicit flag at registration, MODEL_INPUT purpose, preview, request-bound single-use grant, single consume
security_summary.capability_probe: pure function; never resolves a reference
security_summary.logging: no logging of paths or bytes; error detail restricted to enum tokens; no print calls
security_summary.network: no network client imported anywhere in the package; asserted by AST scan and a socket guard
security_summary.temporary_storage: POSIX 0700 root, 0600 files, .part plus atomic rename, retention-aware exit cleanup
security_summary.encrypted_state: optional 2.2 secure store; file name only, account bound into authenticated data

checks.acceptance_listing: pending_cleanup() lists every reference that still holds derived bytes with retention, expiry and presence, without a path

acceptance.case: derived images keep no location or device metadata
small file with huge declared dimensions fails inside the limit
other account, task, purpose or expiry cannot resolve a reference
cancel, timeout and disk-full produce no sendable half-product
errors, logs and manifests carry no encoding, path or credential
temporary directory and descriptors are clean after the task

cross_module_requests.request: Register MEDIA_* codes in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json before they cross the business facade; retryable and user_action already follow the frozen category policy.

Register images with purpose MODEL_INPUT through MediaAssets and send only through prepare_model_bundle -> authorize_model_send -> consume_model_bundle; no second local read path or arbitrary image URL.
Register course attachments with purpose COURSE_RESOURCE and use MediaAssets.source_info for provenance; do not re-implement file checks in the resource module.
Include Pillow==13.0.0 in the final lock and wheel resource manifest; add media_assets/README.md to package-data if the installed layout ships module docs.
Include tests/test_media_assets.py in cross-platform regression; five POSIX-only cases skip on Windows for platform reasons.
Pass the configured 2.1 temp_dir as MediaAssets(temp_root); the directory must be created 0700 by the caller or the module refuses it, and it must not be a user download directory.

remaining_limits: Derived images are always re-encoded: JPEG is lossy (quality 90, stepping down to 60 only to satisfy the 8 MiB limit), ICC is dropped, so the derived hash differs from the source hash by design.
OOXML files are recognised as ZIP containers only; internal document structure is not validated and content is never executed.
Animated WebP/APNG is refused instead of sending only the first frame.
Windows has no POSIX mode bits: derived-file privacy relies on the user-directory ACL; the module rejects reparse points and requires a writable root but does not repeat the 2.2 ACL checks.
Cleanup means closing handles and unlinking files; no physical erasure or secure memory wipe is claimed.
models.py and the generic download path are untouched by design; real model image transfer does not exist until 4.5/6.1 integration.
rollback: Stop calling MediaAssets and remove the controlled temporary directory; original files were never modified and user download directories are untouched.
next_step: Batch integration reconnects 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 on one commit, then runs the batch-level check, the full offline suite and contract linkage before the gate moves.
